facts.fact: Roddie 有测验和周五球赛，答应周末来电。
facts.anchor: Roddie had texted me that he had a quiz to study for and a basketball game Friday night, but promised to call me over the weekend.

facts.fact: Meg 自认伪人：抱怨太年轻当妈，又舍不得卸下母亲的全部重量。
facts.anchor: I’m that hypocrite who complains about becoming a mother too young but I’m not ready to lose any of the crushing weight of that responsibility.

facts.fact: 让出 Rosedale 房子的原因：Joel 在她协助办遗产期间把 Wanda 带上自家床——情感归零，接受买断搬进北约克公寓。
facts.anchor: Also, Joel had screwed Wanda in our bed while I was helping Mom with probate. That soured any lingering sentiment I felt toward our home, so I let him buy me out.

facts.fact: Roddie 十四岁、九月开学前出柜；Meg 自责「三年电话式育儿」连这个都没察觉。
facts.anchor: Roddie was fourteen, and I hadn’t guessed he was gay until he told me and Joel right before school started in September.

facts.fact: 儿子被好友 Tyson 甩——Tyson 转头和 Roddie 幼儿园起的好友 Bethany 在一起；他皱眉的样子神似 Joel。
facts.anchor: “Like with Tyson? He’s with Bethany now.” His lip curled, and his eyebrows pulled into that winged shape Joel’s always made when he was annoyed.

facts.fact: 屏幕里的 Roddie 长出 Joel 年轻时的浓眉与 kicked-dog 表情——提醒她当年真心爱过他父亲。
facts.anchor: Roddie’s brows had thickened with adolescence, forming strong, masculine lines over his golden-brown eyes. In so many ways, he looked like the young Joel my young self had fallen for

facts.fact: 惊喜：十四岁的儿子主动要来维多利亚——周五 PA 日、周四上网课，他周三就能飞。
facts.anchor: Can I come next weekend? We’ve got a PA day Friday, and Thursday’s online.

facts.fact: Shelby 在跟叫 Weston 的人约会；Roddie 吐槽「像在跟冰箱约会」。
facts.anchor: “She’s seeing someone called Weston. I said it sounds like she’s dating a refrigerator.”

facts.fact: 章末笑意淡去：辞职换行的事，得比预期更早向儿子坦白了。
facts.anchor: It faded as I realized I’d have to fess up about my career change sooner than I’d expected.
